Software Engineering Intern, Machine Learning (Summer 2027)
Location: Toronto, ON (hybrid)

About the team
We build computer vision models that help grocery stores keep shelves stocked.

What you'll do
- Train and evaluate PyTorch models on real store images
- Build data pipelines and small FastAPI services around them
- Demo what you built to customers every two weeks

What we're looking for
- In 3rd or 4th year of Computer Science, Engineering or a related program
- Python, plus experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Projects you shipped outside class; hackathon winners are a plus
